assets.title: Letters without an Answer
assets.brief: An ivory correspondence envelope, a cobalt blue ribbon, a SMALL PLAIN BLUE WAX SEAL with no imprinted device. Do not draw any coat of arms or symbol on the seal.

assets.title: Rooms for the Displaced
assets.brief: A little open oak doorway sheltering a neatly folded wool blanket and a travel suitcase. Warm light within the doorway, no light outside the cutout. Ivory and cobalt cloth, dark oak.

assets.title: The County's Own Table
assets.brief: A compact open household account ledger beside a little pile of worn silver coins and a single wheat ear. No legible writing. Ivory, cobalt binding, dark brown wood detail.

assets.title: A Congress of Those Present
assets.brief: A semicircle of three wooden high backed council chairs around a compact oak table with one ivory document. No people, no flags, graphite and cobalt cushions, modest bronze details.

assets.title: A Duty Accepted Freely
assets.brief: A carefully folded ivory constitutional charter resting under a small plain pointed gold circlet, wrapped with black white and cobalt ribbons. Crown is a simple five pointed coronet, NO fleur de lis, NO crosses, NO heraldic animals.

assets.title: Beyond the Palace Door
assets.brief: An open little wooden palace doorway behind a large open schoolbook, a small cobalt satchel beside it. Education outside court. No figures. Paper ivory, cobalt satchel, brown oak.

assets.title: The Household Ledger
assets.brief: A thick cobalt financial ledger opened beside a small brass abacus with evenly spaced beads, an ivory paper receipt sticking from the book. Clean blocky legible silhouettes, no text.

assets.title: An Oath with Limits
assets.brief: A sheathed steel officer sword laid diagonally BEHIND an ivory charter fastened with a cobalt ribbon; charter is visually dominant, steel blade not exposed. No people, no heraldic emblem.

assets.title: The Papers Between Us
assets.brief: Two folded ivory dossiers placed side by side with a small brass balance scale between them, blue and charcoal bindings. Visual of judgement and accountability. No writing.

assets.title: The Keys Held in Trust
assets.brief: A large silver ceremonial key laid diagonally across a folded ivory treaty and a short cobalt ribbon. Key has a simple ring bow and practical teeth, no heraldic emblem or lettering.

assets.title: The Name in the Black Border
assets.brief: A small gold pointed circlet resting on folded charcoal black mourning cloth, one ivory candle beside it. Solemn restrained composition. Plain pointed coronet, no fleur de lis, no crosses.

assets.title: Until the Assembly Meets
assets.brief: A solid small dark oak clerk desk with one closed ivory folder, a plain cobalt desk lamp with warm light confined to objects. Temporary civil administration, no figures, no text.

assets.title: Every District at the Table
assets.brief: Three wooden delegate chairs of equal height gathered around a single ivory constitution roll tied with a blue cord. Black white and cobalt upholstery, restrained silver hardware, no flags or coats of arms.

assets.title: A Union by Consent
assets.brief: Three short black, ivory, and cobalt fabric ribbons joined through a solid silver ring above a thick folded ivory constitutional charter. Clear interlinked union symbol, no crown, no crest, no writing.

assets.title: What the Districts Keep
assets.brief: A small open wooden treasury chest with silver coin stacks split into two neat groups, cobalt account ribbon draped across the front. No gold mountain, no currency signs.

assets.title: The Office Beyond the Name
assets.brief: An empty solid oak council chair, with a silver key and ivory constitutional roll at its feet. Cobalt blue upholstery, simple sober civic authority, no crown, no heraldry.

assets.title: The First Winter Budget
assets.brief: A compact charcoal iron stove with warm orange light in its firebox, a small stack of split firewood and a folded blue budget ledger beside it. No scenery or smoke cloud.

assets.title: Tools Brought out of Storage
assets.brief: A sturdy steel bench vise holding a small clean metal component, one wood handled hammer tucked behind it. Cobalt industrial enamel, graphite steel, warm wood.

assets.title: Roads That Reach a Door
assets.brief: A compact grey stone arched bridge segment, a winding ivory cobbled road crossing it, one small cobalt roadside post. No map, landscape, sky or background scenery.

assets.title: A Place for the Scholars
assets.brief: A well used ivory open book with a brass drawing compass resting on its pages and a small cobalt notebook underneath. Blank pages with minimal unobtrusive lines, no letters.

assets.title: A Trade after Service
assets.brief: A plain steel military helmet placed behind a large carpentry hand plane and a short wood plank. Cobalt folded work apron. Peaceful veteran apprenticeship, no gun, no uniform body.

assets.title: A Different Hand
assets.brief: Two overlapping ivory letters with clearly different simple ink strokes under one silver magnifying glass. Charcoal ink, tiny teal wax fleck, dark cobalt edge. No readable writing or invented glyphs.

assets.title: Behind the Closed Door
assets.brief: A heavy charcoal closed double door with a silver keyhole, a narrow teal inner rim and an ivory evidence folder at the threshold. Subtle intrigue, no face or figure.

assets.title: The Name before the Assembly
assets.brief: An ivory evidence dossier laid on a dark wooden witness lectern, with a small silver balance scale beside it. Charcoal, teal and ivory palette, no judge figure, no words.

assets.title: Under One's Own Name
assets.brief: A silver fountain pen crossing a clean ivory signed paper, with a plain teal wax seal. A confident simple sweeping ink line, no readable letters or heraldic crest. Charcoal shadows, teal accents.

assets.title: A Crown Bound by Its Word
assets.brief: A simple gold pointed imperial coronet set above a firmly clasped ivory constitution, orange red narrow ribbon securing it. No fleur de lis, no cross, no bird, no text.

assets.title: The Towns Reopen

assets.title: Classrooms for the New Reign

assets.title: Debts of the Restoration

assets.title: The Crown and Its Neighbours

assets.title: A Crown Bound by Its Word
